description: Original Saturday-to-Friday convention, including the 8-day 2009 week 17 period which still starts on a Saturday.
Temporary Sunday start caused by the 8-day 2009 week 17 period. Ends with the 6-day 2009 week 22 period, which restores the Saturday phase.
Saturday convention restored from 2009 week 23 until the last Saturday-start period, 2025-12-20 to 2025-12-26.
Permanent Monday-to-Sunday convention from the period labelled 2026 week 1 onward.
